description.value: Baby Dhal Roti Shop is a Trinidadian restaurant on Vancouver's Commercial Drive serving handcrafted recipes passed down through generations — doubles, pholourie, aloo pie, and curries made with locally sourced meats and fresh ingredients. Situated on one of the city's most beloved cycling corridors just south of Broadway, it offers quick phone-order takeout and DoorDash delivery for cyclists looking for a hearty, flavourful refuel. The menu spans vegetarian curries to oxtail, with house-made roti shells also available fresh or frozen.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 23m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (6 spaces) at 57m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for babydhalroti.com loaded successfully and confirms the address, phone, and business identity. The site describes Baby Dhal Roti Shop as a Trinidadian restaurant (OSM tags it as 'jamaican' cuisine — a discrepancy worth flagging). Takeout is confirmed via phone ordering and DoorDash delivery; vegetarian options are explicitly listed on the menu (Veg Aloo, Channa, Bhaji curries). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging on the website or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Trinidadian restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed takeout service and vegetarian options — a practical and distinctive refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering is available via email request to info@babydhalroti.com. Frozen and fresh roti shells can be ordered in bulk.
